response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine staff-level breadth, including hands-on high-throughput distributed systems work (Dunnhumby's millions-of-requests/sec microservices) and current exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq, aligning well with the AI-native engineering mindset the role demands. However, there is no evidence of Python experience anywhere in his skills or work history despite it being an explicit must-have, and his recent roles skew toward generalist full-stack/product work rather than deep architectural ownership of large-scale distributed systems, making his fit uncertain without further probing.
strengths: Extensive (15+ year) engineering career with proven low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems experience (Dunnhumby)
Current hands-on work building AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic developer tooling
Broad technical versatility across web, mobile, embedded, and DevOps/CI infrastructure, plus founder/leadership experience with GISCollective
concerns: No Python listed in skills or any role — a stated must-have technical requirement
Recent roles (re:cinq, Optilyz, RIDE) are primarily TypeScript/Node product engineering rather than deep architectural/distributed-systems ownership
Resume lacks explicit mention of on-call/incident response, stakeholder management, or agile ceremony experience despite long career
